skill.name: ace-step
skill.description: Generate, inpaint, and outpaint music with ACE Step through the RunComfy CLI. The skill routes text-to-audio, multilingual lyrics, time-range repair, and track extension requests to the matching RunComfy endpoint.
skill.summary: Use RunComfy ACE Step endpoints to create, repair, and extend AI-generated music.
skill.author: doany-ai

content.value_statement: Music teams need fast drafts, language variants, and edits without manual audio tools. This skill routes requests to ACE Step on RunComfy for generation, inpainting, and outpainting.
actual_capabilities: Generate 5 to 240 second stereo tracks from genre, mood, instrument, BPM, and vocal tags.
Use ACE Step 1.5 for multilingual lyrics and structured song sections.
Regenerate a selected time range inside an existing track with audio inpainting.
Extend an existing track before or after its current audio with outpainting.
Explain required RunComfy inputs, costs, durations, and exit codes.
Invoke the RunComfy CLI with the endpoint that matches the music task.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI and an authenticated RunComfy account.
Needs HTTPS audio URLs for inpaint and outpaint inputs.
Single calls are limited to about four minutes of generated audio.
Users remain responsible for lyric rights and commercial licensing decisions.

use_cases.title: Prototype Background Tracks
use_cases.description: Game designers can generate low-cost loops from tags, then compare seeds and tempos.

use_cases.title: Localize Vocal Songs
use_cases.description: Marketing teams can create language variants by keeping tags stable and replacing lyrics.

use_cases.title: Repair Existing Audio
use_cases.description: Audio editors can replace a weak bridge or extend a short hook without rebuilding the full track.

prompt_templates.title: Generate an Instrumental Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 60 second instrumental track with ACE Step. Style: lo-fi hip-hop, mellow, rhodes piano, soft drums, 75 BPM.

prompt_templates.title: Create Structured Vocals
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ACE Step 1.5 to make a 90 second indie pop song. Include verse, chorus, bridge, and outro lyrics in Spanish.

prompt_templates.title: Repair a Song Section
prompt_templates.prompt: Use audio-inpaint on my provided track URL. Replace seconds 20 to 40 with a soft piano bridge and no drums.

prompt_templates.title: Extend and Iterate a Hook
prompt_templates.prompt: Use audio-outpaint on my 30 second hook URL. Add a 20 second intro and 45 second outro, then explain seed choices.

output_examples.input: Create a mellow instrumental loop for a puzzle game.
output_examples.output: The skill selects ACE Step base, proposes specific tags, sets a short duration, and saves the generated audio to the output folder.

output_examples.input: Fix the chorus between 30 and 50 seconds in my uploaded song.
output_examples.output: The skill selects audio-inpaint, keeps nearby style tags consistent, and regenerates only the requested time range.

output_examples.input: Turn this 30 second hook into a two minute track.
output_examples.output: The skill selects audio-outpaint, adds intro and outro durations, and warns when the total length approaches the four minute limit.

best_practices: Start with detailed tags, including genre, mood, instruments, tempo, vocal style, and language.
Use fixed seeds when comparing edits or reproducing a chosen draft.
Review third-party audio URLs before using them for inpaint or outpaint tasks.
anti_patterns: Do not use copyrighted lyrics unless you have the required rights.
Do not ask the agent to install CLI tools from unreviewed remote scripts.
Do not submit private audio URLs unless RunComfy processing is acceptable.

faq.question: Does this skill create music directly?
faq.answer: It guides and invokes the RunComfy CLI. RunComfy runs ACE Step and returns audio files.

faq.question: Which ACE Step endpoint should I use?
faq.answer: Use base text-to-audio for drafts, 1.5 for multilingual vocals, inpaint for repairs, and outpaint for extensions.

faq.question: Can I make instrumental tracks?
faq.answer: Yes. Use instrumental lyrics markers and include no-vocal tags for clearer results.

faq.question: How long can each result be?
faq.answer: The documented endpoints support about 5 to 240 seconds per generation call.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible workflows.

faq.question: What data leaves my workspace?
faq.answer: Prompts, lyrics, tags, and provided audio URLs are sent to RunComfy through its CLI.
